end.summary:
- Practised physical and chemical changes using reversibility and formation of new substances.
- Identified signs of chemical change: gas, colour change, heat/light, smell and new solid.
- Distinguished melting from dissolving in examples such as wax, chocolate, ice and sugar in water.
- Initially said a dissolved substance had disappeared; later corrected this, stating it remains present and adds to the mass.
- Teach-back was not passed; confusion about whether dissolving can be reversed remained at the last turn.
end.parentNote: Ananya practised identifying physical changes by checking whether a new substance forms, and chemical changes by looking for signs such as colour change, gas, heat/light and a new solid. They explained examples like melting wax, burning a wick, rusting iron and sugar dissolving in water, and later corrected the idea that dissolved sugar disappears: it remains present and contributes to the mass. The distinction between melting and dissolving still needs practice; at home, compare an ice cube melting with sugar dissolving and discuss what remains present in each case.

agent.plan: Reversibility ki seema; naye substance ka saboot; examples par apply

turns.text: physical hoga? kyunki wo sirf shape badli na, aluminium hi hai, nayi cheez nahi bani... haan, aur bend karke firse sheet bana sakte hain na? matlab reverse bhi kar sakte hain, isliye physical.

Bilkul, sheet ki shape badli, par aluminium hi raha. Wapas mod paana ek clue hai, lekin asli baat hai ki nayi cheez bani ya nahi. Ab mombatti mein wax pighalne aur baati jalne mein kaunsa physical, kaunsa chemical hai, aur dono ka saboot kya hai?

hmm... wax pighalna to physical hai, kyunki wo fir se jam sakta hai, waise hi wax banega, nayi cheez nahi. aur baati jalna... usme to aag lagti hai na, to wo chemical hoga? kyunki wo jal raha hai, usme se dhuan aur raakh banti hai, wo nayi cheez hai. par ruko... kya raakh ko wapas baati bana sakte hain? nahi na, to wo reverse nahi hoga, isliye chemical. haan, yehi hoga.

Aapne wax aur baati ke liye nayi cheez banne ka saboot socha; reverse hona bhi ek clue hai. Ab railing par laal-bhoori parat banti hai, jiske gun iron se alag hain. Yeh physical change hai ya chemical change, aur aap kis saboot se kahenge?

chemical hoga... kyunki nayi cheez bani na, laal-bhoori parat, uske gun bhi alag hain. jaise... iron strong hota hai, par wo jo parat hai wo to toot-ti si hoti hai, waise powder type? to wo nayi cheez hai, isliye chemical. par maine suna tha rust ko saaf kar sakte hain? matlab wapas iron bana sakte hain kya? nahi pata.

Bilkul, alag gun wali laal-bhoori parat banna chemical change ka saboot hai. Rust ko saaf karne se neeche bacha iron dikh sakta hai, par saaf kiya rust apne aap iron nahi ban jaata. Ab chemical badlav ke do sanket bataiye?

sanket matlab... signs, right? jaise dhuan aaya, aag lagi... aur kya? umm... wo jo laal bhoori parat bani usme colour change hua na, iron grey tha par wo laal bhoora ho gaya? to colour change bhi ek sign hai? waise ma'am, wo rust wala board pe dikhao na, waise hi laal bhoora wala, mujhe dekhna hai.

Haan, sanket matlab signs. Rang badalna ek sanket ho sakta hai; rust mein laal-bhoori parat bhi banti hai. Rust lagi railing ki tasveer abhi ban rahi hai, ismein lagbhag pandrah second lagenge; tab tak sochiye, grey iron par khurduri laal-bhoori parat kaisi dikhegi.

haan, dikh raha hai... grey iron ke upar laal-bhoora sa powder type, rough sa. accha dikha. to sanket, ek to colour change, jaise yahan grey se laal-bhoora. aur dusra... hmm... wo baati jalne mein dhuan aur aag thi, to heat ya light bhi ek sign hai kya?

Haan, heat ya light nikalna bhi chemical badlav ka sanket ho sakta hai. Aapne rang badalne ka example bhi diya; sirf ek sanket se faisla nahi hota, nayi cheez banne ka saboot dekhte hain. Ab do saaf solutions milane par mixture dhundhla ho aur safed solid dikhe, toh chemical change ka sabse mazboot saboot kya hoga?

hmm... safed solid dikha na, to naya solid bana, wo solid pehle nahi tha solutions mein, to nayi cheez bani, isliye chemical change hua. par ma'am, wo solid ka photo dikhao na, aise white powder type, mujhe dekhna hai.

Aap safed solid dekhna chahti hain. Do saaf liquids milne par jo safed solid dikhta hai, uski tasveer abhi ban rahi hai; lagbhag pandrah second lagenge. Tab tak use paani mein tairte chhote safed kanon jaisa sochiye, zaroori nahi ki woh sookha powder ho.

accha... to wo solid ke chhote chhote pieces honge, jaise doodh mein kuch gir gaya ho? par ma'am, solid dikh raha hai to matlab naya solid bana, wo sabse pakka saboot hai na? kyunki pehle to sab saaf tha, ab solid aaya.

Haan, pehle dono solutions saaf the aur milane par safed solid dikha; naya solid banna yahaan sabse mazboot saboot hai. Tasveer abhi aane ki pushti nahi mili hai. Ab Kunal kehta hai ki paani mein namak pighal gaya; use kaunsa shabd bolna chahiye, aur yeh barf pighalne se kaise alag hai?

accha... Kunal kya keh raha hai? ki namak pighal gaya? par namak to ghulta hai na, ice ki tarah pighalta nahi hai... to use 'dissolve' bolna chahiye, ya 'ghulna'? haan, wo shabd use karna chahiye. aur alag kaise hai? hmm... barf pighalne mein paani banta hai, par wo fir se jam sakta hai, waise hi barf ban sakta hai, matlab reverse ho sakta hai. lekin namak paani mein ghul gaya to... wo gayab ho ga

Haan, sahi shabd ghulna hai, pighalna nahi. Aap keh rahi hain ki namak ghulkar gayab ho gaya; lekin dikhna band hona aur wazan khatam hona alag baatein hain. Glass mein paani tolne ke baad cheeni gholen, toh glass ka wazan badhega, utna hi rahega ya ghatega?

hmm... cheeni gayab ho jayegi dikhne se, par wo to andar hi hai na, to wazan to badhega? jaise, pehle sirf paani tha, ab paani + cheeni, to zyada hona chahiye. lekin... ma'am, wazan badhega na? kyunki cheeni to hai, bas dikhti nahi. par iska photo dikhao na, kitchen wala, taraazu aur glass ke saath, mujhe dekhna hai. aur haan, maine ek baar cartoon mein dekha tha, ek hathi paani mein ghul gaya tha

Aapka tark hai ki cheeni dikhti nahi, par glass mein rehti hai; taraazu se ise jaanch sakte hain. Cartoon wala hathi mazedaar tha, lekin asli hathi paani mein cheeni ki tarah nahi ghulta. Kitchen ke taraazu par glass ki tasveer abhi ban rahi hai, lagbhag pandrah second lagenge; tab tak sochiye, cheeni daalne se pehle aur baad taraazu kya dikhayega.
badhega, obviously. cheeni to andar hai na, gayab nahi hui hai asli mein, bas dikhti nahi. to wazan badhega. par ma'am, photo abhi bhi nahi aaya, whiteboard pe kuch nahi likha. taraazu kahan hai?

Haan, wazan badhega: cheeni dikhti nahi, par glass mein hi rehti hai. Ab do drinks mein, paani mein cheeni mil rahi hai aur chocolate garam ho rahi hai; kis mein ghulna ho raha hai aur kis mein pighalna, aur kaise pata chalega?

paani mein cheeni ka dissolving hua, aur chocolate ka melting. aur cheeni ab bhi maujood hai, dikhti nahi par andar hai. par ma'am, melting aur dissolving ka drawing dikhao na whiteboard pe, mujhe dekhna hai. jaise paani mein cheeni ke chhote dots gayab hote hue aur chocolate liquid type.

Aapne cheeni ko paani mein ghulna aur chocolate ko pighalna bataya, aur kaha ki cheeni ab bhi andar hai. Photo abhi nahi aaya; main whiteboard par cheeni ke chhote dots wala glass bana rahi hoon. Chocolate ko garam karne par woh liquid hoti hai, bina paani mein mile.

hmm... ghee pighalna... wo to physical hai na? kyunki ghee pighal kar fir se jam sakta hai, jaise mummy fridge mein rakhti hai to solid ho jata hai. to wo reversible hai. par ma'am, iska matlab sab physical changes reversible hote hain kya? jaise doodh se dahi bana, wo bhi wapas doodh ban sakta hai kya?

Aapka sawaal achha hai: nahi, sab physical changes reversible nahi hote. Kaagaz phaadne par naya substance nahi banta, phir bhi use pehle jaisa jodna mushkil hai; dahi se doodh bhi wapas nahi banta, kyunki dahi banne mein naya substance banta hai. Ab poster kaatna aur sparkler jalna, dono ko ulta karna mushkil hai: inmein chemical change kaunsa hai, aur sirf reversibility dekhna kyon kaafi nahi?
